title: Benefit Plan Standard Formulary List
description: A drug list written once for the plans that share it (new in v1.2.0). Many plans use 1 formulary: in the CMS monthly Part D formulary files for contract year 2027, 286 formularies serve 5,492 plans, up to 660 plans each, so a list written into every plan document would be written up to 660 times. A plan document names the list with pharmacy.formulary_reference.formulary_items_url and keeps in its own pharmacy.formulary_items only what is the plan's alone; an item there replaces a list item with the same rxcui and coverage_basis. The list carries no tiers: each item's formulary_tier_id names a tier in the pharmacy.formulary_tiers of every plan document that points at the list. The item and reference shapes are the core schema's (benefit-plan.schema.json in this folder), so a validator loads both files.

formulary_reference.description: Identity and provenance of the list: formulary_id and formulary_version as the source names them, completeness, and data_sources. source_plan_identifiers and formulary_items_url, which describe 1 plan, are left out of a list.

plan_year.description: The coverage year the list applies to (e.g. 2027), the core schema's plan_year: a formulary id can carry a different list in another year.

formulary_items.description: The drugs on the list, in the shape of the core schema's pharmacy.formulary_items[].

source_references.description: Citations for the list as a whole, such as the source file's header row, in the shape of the core schema's source_references.

schema_version.description: Version of the Benefit Plan Standard schema used to validate this document (e.g. '1.2.0').
